QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Heliseum Reclamation HQ
QuestInfo.0: Visit Beldar in Pantheon and let him know you're there to support the Heliseum Reclamation campaign.
QuestInfo.1: Magnus' forces are stronger than you expected. Hurry to the Heliseum Reclamation HQ, and do what you can for Edea and Piston, the commanders there.
QuestInfo.2: You found Tiron in Heliseum. Help out however you can.

default.0: Climb the stairs to the right and take the portal to #bHeliseum#k. #bTiron#k will be waiting for you there, with instructions.
